6.387 rsInvalidAggregateIndicatorField
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidAggregateIndicatorField is a critical error that occurs when a Field.AggregateIndicatorField
contains a string that does not match the name of another Field in the same DataSet.<196>
